about_the_game: "Xuan Ying" is a game set in a fantasy martial arts world. It primarily follows the protagonist's continuous training and growth in the martial world, as they courageously battle the antagonist cult "Evil Sect" and the foreign invaders "Northern Di," navigating skillfully among various major forces to become a renowned supreme master in the martial world. Their story spans far and wide, creating a legendary tale in the martial world.
